I have some schooling and many seasons on this land, so I do not farm by guesswork. This plot is big, I own it, and in Kilimanjaro I have seen maize do better when I plant improved seed and feed it, but I still watch cash carefully, so I will not push fertilizer too high. Because I am old and this is nearly 6 hectares, my family will do part of the work and I will bring in hired labor for land preparation, weeding, and harvesting.
